publicMapLead: Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA), including Minya directorate/image-map and historical/digital map pages; no public parcel feature service verified.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery queries were performed. They identified ESA first-party map/survey material and Beni Mazar tax-office pages, but no city-specific public cadastral registry, parcel viewer, or parcel API.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET requests to ESA main, historical zemam maps, governorate directorate map, national maps, and digital-map workflow pages returned 200 HTML. The observed forms/pages exposed map information and office/digital-map request workflows, not parcel features. Beni Mazar ETA pages returned 200 but were excluded as tax-office rather than cadastral evidence.

No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.

qualification.reason: No city-specific first-party parcel response was verified during this attempt; research is complete but source admission is not justified.

uncertainty: ESA digital or historical products may be available through an office-request workflow or an unlinked service not exposed in the inspected public pages. This limitation is recorded as unavailable evidence, not proof that Beni Mazar lacks cadastral records.
